system issuer

  • CURIE: gmeow:systemIssuer
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/systemIssuer
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/norms

The agent or standpoint that issues a normative system as a whole. ⊑ normIssuer: issuing the system is issuing its stance. Member norms may still carry their own issuers (an annex contributed by another party).

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:NormativeSystem -> ? Sub-property of: gmeow:normIssuer

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:systemIssuer from gmeow:NormativeSystem to ? when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:normIssuer, gmeow:NormativeSystem
